name: v13 fixed-predictor learned-gate comparison and non-WAPE external evaluation
registration_scope: Local timestamped code/protocol freeze; not a public preregistration.
historical_scope: These datasets have no prior evaluation recorded in the available study conversation. This is not a universal claim about every collaborator.

prior_information.previous_results: M5 and Dominicks v12 outcomes were known. This separate test addresses non-WAPE scope and a learned-gate baseline and does not replace Dominicks.
prior_information.public_metadata_seen: Official dataset sizes, feature/label counts, publication references, ARFF/XML format, official train/test existence and Mediamill split counts.
prior_information.v12_source_status: Unavailable in the current execution session. New code is independent; exact identity of the old Mixed rule has not been verified.

data_selection: Both fixed before raw acquisition. No replacement or new dataset based on success, failure, direction, or precision.

acquisition.redirects: Official SourceForge/sf.net hosts only; no alternate source after failure.

data_license_scope: Public academic benchmark source; no separately verified dataset license. Do not infer a data license from Mulan software licensing.

splits.official_train: Sort by SHA256 first 64 bits; first floor(.7 n) point T, remainder head/gate H.
splits.official_test: Sort by SHA256 first 64 bits; first floor(n/3) A, next floor(n/3) B, remainder E.
splits.duplicates: Describe exact feature duplicates across roles; preserve official partitions and do not exclude or resplit.
splits.opening_semantics: Raw parsing materializes the labels. Only T/H/A labels influence fitting/design. A records precede B calculations, and B records precede E calculations; no physical sealed-label claim.

prediction.classifier: One binary L2 LogisticRegression per label, C=1, liblinear, tol=.0001, max_iter=1000, no class weights.
prediction.scaler: StandardScaler(with_mean=False), fitted on point T only.
prediction.constant_label: (positives_T+1)/(n_T+2) if only one class is observed in T.
prediction.prediction_set: p>=.5; if empty, take one maximum-probability label, exact ties by source label order.
prediction.warnings: Record convergence warnings; do not refit with altered settings.
prediction.loss: False positives in the fixed complete predicted-label set.
prediction.exposure: Number of predicted positive labels, exactly known at decision time and at least one.
prediction.abstention: Accept/reject the entire predicted-label set for each example; never individual labels.

common_selector_features: Point-scaled original feature matrix plus log1p(exact predicted-positive count).

menu.threshold: Lexicographic score/hash boundary; same outcome-independent hash for all methods, a fixed implementation of boundary randomization.
menu.design: Largest A-feasible prefix at risk .95*r and case coverage>=.40.
menu.selection: Each utility maximized across eligible menu members; exact utility ties retain first fixed menu entry.

direct_gates.name: Custom primal-dual MLP, not a SelectiveNet reproduction
direct_gates.updates: Minibatch Adam primal updates; once-per-epoch dual ascent on all H rows.
direct_gates.initialization: Same seed and initialization for both utilities within a dataset.
direct_gates.calibration: Same A threshold feasibility and hash boundary as every menu score.

risk_design.A_dependence_of_training: Only the A-derived cap scalar is used by H-only direct-gate training.

screen.resampling: Paired row multinomial bootstrap, fixed n draws per resample.
screen.pass: A eligible, positive accepted exposure in every resample, signed-excess upper<0.
screen.after_failure: No fallback or reselection. E metrics are still computed for all declared methods.

later.coverage: case=mean(a), exposure=sum(a*w)/sum(w) recalculated within every resample.

primary_family.contrasts: menu exposure choice minus menu case choice, c and d, both datasets

secondary_family.contrasts: direct minus menu for matched utility, c and d, both datasets

later.zero_acceptance: Risk undefined, coverages zero. Show explicit status rather than inventing a risk.
later.no_global_95_claim: The screen and two contrast families are separately adjusted; no single 95% statement across all three families.

success.per_dataset: Both selected menu policies pass B and adjusted E upper(delta c)<0 and lower(delta d)>0.
success.learned_gate_superiority: No predeclared universal superiority claim. Report all matched-utility effects and screen status.

failure_rules: Acquisition, schema, zero cap, insufficient role size, or numerical failure is recorded without automatic dataset substitution, refit, or tuning. Any later implementation-only repair requires a separate dated amendment retaining the original failure.
inference_scope: Descriptive bootstrap conditional on fitted models and A design, under row-exchangeability approximation. Unknown document duplicates and Mediamill shot/video dependence limit uncertainty interpretation. No population risk guarantee, no demonstrated training convergence, and no claim that one untuned MLP represents all learned selectors.
report_all: All primary and secondary comparisons including failed screens
